hook: A manufacturer recalled 3,662,000 ladders after lock failures caused head injuries.

sections.voiceover: A manufacturer recalled 3,662,000 ladders after lock failures caused head injuries.
b_roll: Graphic showing 3,662,000 ladder recall count with warning icon

sections.voiceover: Why do 3,662,000 Little Giant Ladder Systems units retract when Rapid Locks fail to engage fully?
b_roll: Diagram showing Rapid Locks mechanism failure

sections.voiceover: But the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission logged 25 reports of these sudden lock failures.
b_roll: Document graphic displaying 25 reported collapse incidents

sections.voiceover: Rapid Locks fail to engage, causing 19 victims to suffer skull fractures and traumatic brain injuries. Consumer Product Safety Commission confirms 25 total incidents involving these 3,662,000 recalled units.
b_roll: Bar chart showing 19 total reported injuries
List displaying head injuries concussions and skull fractures
Official seal graphic for U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission

sections.voiceover: Ensure your Rapid Locks are fully engaged to prevent the retraction hazards causing 19 reported injuries.
b_roll: Summary graphic displaying 19 injuries and 3,662,000 recalled ladders
